parserContract.format: Native GeoJSON FeatureCollection, finite scalar properties, source feature IDs, native geometries
parserContract.evidence: Source SHA256, native feature ID, original JSON property path/value, geometry JSON and mapped schema hash
parserContract.scope: Explicit native eight-digit AGS only, leading zeroes preserved; geometry alone never assigns a municipality
parserContract.schema: Reviewed mapped keys/type constraints; extra unmapped scalar properties do not become claims; nullable values remain null
parserContract.rights: Layer-specific admitted receipt must match the snapshot policy receipt; defaults all held
parserContract.pagination: Native next links reported, no hidden requests or completeness claim
parserContract.withdrawal: Only explicit native status is attributed; no tombstone from absence
